summary:
Fixed and verified. ✅

**The needle:** `incrementCounter()` in `app/app/counter.js` used a non-atomic read-modify-write — `GET` the value, add 1 in JS, then `SET` it back. Under concurrency, multiple requests read the same value before any wrote back, so increments were silently lost (a classic lost-update race).

**The fix:** Replaced the GET/SET pair with Redis's atomic `INCR`, which increments server-side in a single operation.

Test result: 100 concurrent increments → counter reads exactly 100. `PASS`.
